players.product: High-capacitance MLCCs (CGA/C series) for power-delivery decoupling

quarterly_data.quarter: TDK press release: Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors: TDK launches (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TDK expanded its CN series of low-resistance soft-termination SMD MLCCs with a 100 V X7R part rated 10 uF in the 3225 format (3.2 x 2.5 x 2.5 mm), which TDK calls industry-leading; mass production is scheduled to begin in September 2026. Target use is smoothing and decoupling of 48 V power lines in AI servers, humanoid robots, xEVs and industrial equipment; TDK says the parts achieve twice the capacitance of its conventional capacitors of the same size while significantly reducing ESR, halving the number of MLCCs in the mounting area. Automotive (CNA, AEC-Q200) and commercial (CNC) versions.
quarterly_data.figure: 100 V, 10 uF, 3225 format; mass production from September 2026
